VisualLanguage.rendering: flat colour, no outlines unless one of the four colours is free for them

rules: There are only four colours. Every area is exactly one of them.
Use blue as the darkest colour for outlines and shadows.

LineAndShape.shapes: very large and blocky; pixels are almost twice as wide as they are tall

TypographyPolicy.default: No words, letters, numbers or pseudo-text.

CompositionPolicy.screen: A full playfield or scene that fills the frame.
CompositionPolicy.sprite: One subject, centred, with even padding on all sides.
CompositionPolicy.sprite-sheet: One subject in each cell, the same scale and baseline in every cell, no overlap.
CompositionPolicy.concept: A mood picture for discussion; not converted.
